name: independent-proxy
reviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat)

steps.action: Sign in through the public HTTPS origin the proxy serves
steps.actual: Signed in at https://openlaw-review.localhost:43372 through the local Caddy instance, which terminates TLS with its internal CA and forwards to the app container. The browser context accepts that private CA; this does not test public certificate issuance.

steps.action: A sign-in posted with a wrong Origin is refused
steps.actual: Posting the same sign-in with Origin https://not-the-configured-origin.example was refused with HTTP 403, so the app compares the forwarded Origin against BASE_URL.

steps.action: Upload and download a Document through the proxy
steps.actual: Uploaded and downloaded a Document entirely through the HTTPS origin; the downloaded bytes matched the uploaded SHA-256.

steps.action: A live update arrives on /api/events through the proxy
steps.error:
page.evaluate: Error: no event within 30s
    at eval (eval at evaluate (:311:30), <anonymous>:3:59)

note: The first three steps passed. The event-stream step used EventSource.onmessage, which never fires for the named SSE frames this stream sends, so it timed out. The retry read the raw stream instead; the invitation-origin step it never reached is in independent-proxy-invite.
